mapper.select: SELECT id, account, created_auth_id, level, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM auth WHERE status_auth = 0 ORDER BY gmt_create DESC

SELECT id, account, created_auth_id, level, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM auth
AND account LIKE concat('%',#{account},'%')
AND level = #{level}
AND status_auth = 0
ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
SELECT id, account, created_auth_id, level, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM auth WHERE id = #{id} AND status_auth =0

SELECT id,account,created_auth_id createdAuthId,level,gmt_create gmtCreate,gmt_modified gmtModified,password,`lock`,status_auth statusAuth, refresh_token refreshToken FROM auth WHERE account = #{account} AND status_auth =0

SELECT id,account,created_auth_id createdAuthId,level,gmt_create gmtCreate,gmt_modified gmtModified,password,`lock`,status_auth statusAuth, refresh_token refreshToken FROM auth WHERE id = #{id} AND status_auth =0

select a.id,a.phone,a.gmt_create gmtCreate,a.real_name realName,a.address,a.recommend_user_id recommendUserId,b.real_name recommendUser,a.school_id schoolId,c.school_name schoolName from message_phone a left join recommend_user b on a.recommend_user_id = b.id left join school c on a.school_id=c.id order by a.gmt_create desc
